integrity: A complete 134-face acyclic Hasse matching and exact all-simplex symmetry trace checker is embedded and reproducible using Python 3 standard library. Infinite extent follows from the explicit natural two-petal homotopy decomposition.
scientific_limitations: Only common-vertex bouquets of unfilled five-cycles and robustness threshold three are classified. The homotopy equivalence is not asserted to be equivariant; quotient homology is over the rationals. An equivalent unindexed result could exist; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: A signed pair-homology lattice for three-robust pentagonal bouquets
